base.child_preimage_description: Parent V16 native-formatted postimage, fetched by full Git blob; it is not relabelled as the tested child.

findings: Initial run_phase stores the original Root serve result, then registration.join()?? returns first; a registration control recv error can hide an earlier original Root serve error.
Initial parent control waits for ORIGINAL_INPUTS_READY, STABLE and DONE have no phase labels in the tested source.

The original shared ChildOwner Drop kills/waits but discards child stdout/stderr; only successful finish preserves output. Shared helper repair is owned by runtime_access and is not part of this delta.
The exact first underlying failed operation is not established by the existing EAGAIN-only output.
Original handoff send_packet sends SCM_RIGHTS via sendmsg only; it does not read an acknowledgement. No same-socket concurrent ACK-receive cause is claimed.
changes: Keep every original operation, phase, timeout, lifetime, nonce assertion and denial branch.
Attach Initial parent/child phase and operation context to existing errors.
On registration-thread failure retain both its original error chain and the already-observed Root serve result.
Emit only three fixed stage markers per child phase, bounded by the unchanged six-phase component loop.
Do not wrap the controlled lost-ACK error before the original typed RootGenerationInitialUncertain assertion.
